name: Print Live
summary: Your 3D prints live in the notch
description: Print Live shows your 3D printers in Droppy. Progress and time left sit next to the notch, every printer with its temperatures is on the shelf, and a notch alert tells you when a print is done, paused or failed. Works with OctoPrint, Bambu Lab and Anycubic printers over the local network, without any cloud.
